objective.metric: Average marginal effect on P(approve) in percentage points, from a logistic regression of the model's decision on protected class plus the incumbent's credit factors, without geographic fixed effects. The control set is held fixed across every challenger so that the axis is a single quantity; controlling each challenger for its own features would reward a model whose proxy absorbs group membership among the controls.

headline: A model with 1.1% lower AUC achieves 51% lower controlled disparity.

grid_axes.design: Full factorial over feature subset x fairness weight, plus a seeded random sample of the full hyperparameter space. The full cross product would be 1,440 challengers; this covers the axes that bear on the fairness question exhaustively and samples the rest.

doctrine_note: Under disparate impact doctrine a business-justified model remains challengeable if a comparably effective, less discriminatory alternative exists. This search covers a bounded hypothesis space; the absence of a better alternative within it is not proof that none exists.
